svg.desc: SW FMEA failure chains, sheet 5 of 7 (SWF rev 0.6): failure modes SWF-034 to SWF-040 (7 failure modes, 12 causes), each drawn as structure element, function, failure mode with severity, guideword and end effect, and its causes with occurrence, detection, Action Priority and actions.
svg.text: Figure 3-6 · SW FMEA failure chains — sheet 5 of 7

S = severity of the failure mode (max of its effects); O / D = occurrence / detection of the cause; “in <element>” = structure element where the cause lies; “→” = linked failure mode in another FMEA; hazard = HARA hazard of an end effect.
